read_by: kerbfront opus (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium): wall 0: 4 views; wall 3: 4 views
notes: The grid is smeared by the fire escape and wires, and the east end beyond about u 14 is unclear in the grid. The side window groups repeat at 9.4 m and match the overlay. Shop fascias were lowered to the grid sign line (about v 2.2-2.8). Amro signs predate the record, so it has a plain record-name board. The existing sign reads AMRO MARKET LIQUOR in black and red on white. | Window rows are realigned to the grid at a 2.62 m pitch. The centre and right bays are moved left to match the grid. The east end of the grid is squashed by the Van Ness return, so the wide corner column of windows is placed from photos 2 and 3. Bay projection is estimated. The billboard at u≈14–17 is advertising and is left out. The diner signage is as photographed in 2021–22. Amro Market uses plain signs with the record name because the photos predate the 2023 tenant.
